simple.meaning: תׇּכְנִית (toknîyth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “admeasurement , i.e. consummation.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezekiel 28:12. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תׇּכְנִית (H8508) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תׇּכְנִית (toknîyth) / H8508 is traced through Ezekiel 28:12, Ezekiel 43:10 with generated occurrence evidence.
